workflow.name: Collect historical price data from Polymarket Up/Down markets
workflow.description: Two-phase workflow: (1) Collect all event IDs from a Polymarket series slug, (2) Batch-fetch historical price data for closed markets and store locally (mock Supabase).

MOCK_EVENT_TABLE.description: Path to the local JSON file for event metadata storage

MOCK_SUPABASE_TABLE.description: Path to the local JSON file for price data storage (mock Supabase)

DEFAULT_SLUG.description: Default Polymarket market slug for testing

workflow_steps.name: provide_slug
workflow_steps.description: User provides the slug of a Polymarket Up/Down market

workflow_steps.name: find_event_id_from_slug
workflow_steps.description: Find the event ID from the market slug via gamma-api

workflow_steps.name: find_series_id_from_event
workflow_steps.description: Find the series ID from the first event ID

workflow_steps.name: find_all_events_for_series
workflow_steps.description: Find all events belonging to the series

workflow_steps.name: split_events
workflow_steps.description: Split events array into individual event records

workflow_steps.name: register_events
workflow_steps.description: Register each event into the local event table

workflow_steps.name: fetch_unprocessed_events
workflow_steps.description: Fetch up to 100 unprocessed events from the event table

workflow_steps.name: fetch_up_down_tokens
workflow_steps.description: Fetch UP/DOWN token IDs and end time for each event

workflow_steps.name: extract_and_store_tokens
workflow_steps.description: Extract tokens/endtime and store in event table

workflow_steps.name: check_market_closed
workflow_steps.description: Check if the market is closed; skip open markets

workflow_steps.name: convert_endtime_to_unix
workflow_steps.description: Convert end time to Unix timestamp (closed markets only)

workflow_steps.name: set_start_time
workflow_steps.description: Set start time = end time - 3600 seconds (1 hour market)

workflow_steps.name: fetch_price_history
workflow_steps.description: Fetch price history for the UP token in the time window

workflow_steps.name: split_prices_and_timestamps
workflow_steps.description: Split price history into separate arrays

workflow_steps.name: store_in_supabase
workflow_steps.description: Store price data in mock Supabase (local JSON)
